name: quizjumper
description: QuizJumper multiplayer-core: Node/TypeScript backend + Angular/Phaser frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
